title: This game is your elevator to English – level 3
paragraphs: What is LangoPlay? LangoPlay is like an elevator that can take you up to an intermediate level of English. It helps you move from your current level to a point where you know around 2,500 words.
These 2,500 words cover about 90% of everyday spoken English. At this level, you will have the vocabulary and basic grammar to communicate in everyday situations.
So, what is the best way to get there? Play LangoPlay every day. Complete at least one chapter a day and try to earn all the stars.
In the Listening section, listen carefully to the whole chapter several times until you understand it perfectly.

Then cover the left-hand side of the Listening section and translate the text back into your native language. Practice the translation several times until you can translate it perfectly. Then go to the next chapter.

Throughout the game, focus carefully on understanding the meaning. Imagine what you are reading, hearing, or saying. Try to see the people, places, and situations in your mind. This focus on meaning is important. It helps you remember new vocabulary for much longer.
Start using LangoPlay today. Start for free at langoplay.com.
